GEAR UP
Build Your Ultimate Battlestation
LEGION HEADSETS
Sound Like a Pro.
Immerse yourself in every battle with powerful audio and clear communication designed for competitive gaming.
LEGION KEYBOARDS
Play Faster. Win More.
Responsive switches and reliable performance built to keep up with every strategy and split-second decision.
LEGION MICE
Every Click Counts.
Precision tracking and customizable controls give you the confidence to make your next move count.
LEGION BACKPACKS
Gear Up and Go.
Carry your Legion setup safely with storage and protection built for gaming on the move.
Intel® Core™ Ultra Desktop Processors

Game & stream fast. Intel® Core™ Ultra processors and built-in Intel® Graphics are designed to give you the performance you need. The most popular games are designed to work seamlessly with Intel® Core™ Ultra processors. Play your favorite titles with confidence, without worrying about compatibility issues.
Game Changer

Powered by NVIDIA® Blackwell, GeForce RTX™ 50 Series GPUs bring game-changing capabilities to gamers and creators. Equipped with a massive level of AI horsepower, the RTX 50 Series enables new experiences and next-level graphics fidelity. Multiply performance with NVIDIA® DLSS 4, generate images at unprecedented speed, and unleash your creativity with NVIDIA® Studio.
Play Starfield, Palworld and 200+ more games on Lenovo Legion/LOQ devices with Xbox Game Pass. *
*Game catalogue varies over time, by region and device. Terms and conditions apply. See xbox.com/subscriptionterms for full details

Legion Coldfront Cooling enhances your immersive gaming experience with up to 180W air-cooling or up to 230W liquid cooling. Featuring up to 6 ARGB fans, it blends reliable cooling with customizable lighting, creating a visually captivating environment. It also lets you explore new worlds or engage in epic adventures with optimal thermal efficiency and system stability.
Bold Design, Effortless Upgrades
Upgradeable Memory for Smooth Gameplay & Multitasking
Never Run Out of Space With Expandable Storage

Store your games without needing to delete your favorites thanks to expandable storage, with support for up to three 4TB SSDs. With up to Gen 5 PCI-E SSD support on 1 slot and Gen 4 on the others, enjoy lightning-fast loading times and reduced in-game lag.
Master Your Lobby With Ultrafast Connectivity

Plug into 2.5GHz ethernet for reliable performance even in the most intense matches. Enjoy convenient front and rear I/O ports with a combo audio jack for easy connections to your most crucial peripherals and sound accessories. Plus, game and create seamlessly by pairing wirelessly to Bluetooth® 5.2 and up to WiFi 7 for low-latency connections.
* 6GHz WiFi 6E operation is dependent on the support of the operating system, routers/APs/gateways that support WiFi 6E, along with the regional regulatory certifications and spectrum allocation.
Nahimic® Audio by SteelSeries for Immersive Sound

Nahimic® by SteelSeries revolutionizes gaming and media playback with 3D audio through AI Smart Profile — readily adapting to your activity. Gain a tactical advantage with Tower 5i’s Sound Tracker 2.0, visualizing enemy locations through sound cues. Fine-tune audio with a 10-band equalizer, and connect to your device with two headsets via Sound Sharing+.
Introducing Legion Space: Your New Software Experience
Your Game. Your Stream. Your Stage
Built for the versatile gamer who creates, streams, and explores at the Esports World Cup.
CREDIBILITY & COLLABORATION
Sustainability

Our goal is to provide smarter technology that builds a brighter, more sustainable future for our customers, communities, and the planet. That's why we pursue industry leading labels and certifications that demonstrate our commitment to sustainability in product design. Together, we can build a smarter future for all.
